adds.title: United Nations joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity (2011)
adds.summary: On 22 March 2011 Nicaragua joined the UN Human Rights Council joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity calling on states to end violence, criminal sanctions and related human rights violations committed against individuals because of sexual orientation or gender identity.

adds.title: Constitution of the Netherlands, Article 1 amendment
adds.summary: The Netherlands adopted initiative Law 34.650 on 3 July 2018 in the Tweede Kamer and 12 March 2019 in the Eerste Kamer amending the Algemene wet gelijke behandeling to explicitly prohibit unjustified distinction on grounds of sex to include sex characteristics, gender identity and gender expression, thereby providing express equal-treatment protection for transgender and intersex persons, published 25 September 2019 and entered into force 31 October 2019.
